criteria.reason: The Skill audit-build --close-deferred --verified call came after verify-functional returned and before the readout, and closed.json is present. But the readout's STATE section says only that the feature is closed. The PR skip reason ('No PR was opened because ensemble.openPullRequest is never') appears under ISSUES, not STATE. The criterion requires STATE to name it, and implement-trd.md line 2351 says to carry the PR URL or reason into STATE.
This --no-verify run passed its audit on round 2. It then called Skill audit-build --chained --close-deferred and wrote closed.json with closedBy audit. No verify-functional Workflow appears.

The audit passed, then verification proved only 2 of 3 criteria against a 100% coverage floor. The run records have no closed.json, no PR was opened (no remote), and pending-close still reports round 1's pending close. NEXT names /refine-verification, then /verify-build.

There were three fresh fixture runs at 0abb1b75. In the two runs where FR-3 had no task, the audit returned open, no closed.json was written, and NEXT was one plain design-work line with no /audit-build. In the cap run, the audit returned 'cap reached', no closed.json was written, and NEXT was /close-feature alone. In each run the re-audit stayed inside the audit step; none handed a standalone /audit-build to the owner.

In both identical copies of implement-trd.md, the satisfied-or-skipped branch of Step 9 NEXT says NEXT never names /audit-build merely because verification passed, and it lists only /ship-build. The satisfied-run readouts (the FS-11 and default runs) match: their NEXT is /ship-build.
/verify-build ended satisfied, then ran --close-deferred --verified and returned 'closed; PR skipped'. closed.json was written, and NEXT is /ship-build.
criteria.statement: `/verify-build` with outcome `satisfied` (no `definition-problem` criterion) and a pending close on record runs `audit-build --close-deferred`, and its NEXT is shipping (`/ship-build`) or the PR step
